rules: Build phases sequentially; do not skip.
Use exact package/file names from this spec.
Write compiling code; no TODO() placeholders.
Run `./gradlew assembleDebug` after each phase; must succeed.
Always use start/end (never left/right) in Compose for RTL.
Never hardcode strings; use stringResource(); provide en/fr/ar.
Ask before adding any dependency not listed here.

phases.name: Scaffold
tasks: Create settings.gradle.kts, root build.gradle.kts, gradle/libs.versions.toml, app/build.gradle.kts.
AndroidManifest with .EmployeeApp (@HiltAndroidApp) + .MainActivity (exported), supportsRtl=true, localeConfig.
res/xml/locales_config.xml listing en, fr, ar.
EmployeeApp.onCreate sets POI XMLInputFactory/XMLOutputFactory/XMLEventFactory to com.fasterxml.aalto.stax.*.
MainActivity: setContent { AppTheme { Surface { Text("Hello") } } }.
Add ProGuard rules (see proguard section).

phases.name: Theme + Locale + Nav Shell
tasks: presentation/theme/{Color,Type,Shape,Theme}.kt. Type uses Cairo (AR) + Inter (Latin) fonts in res/font/.
AppTheme() wraps CompositionLocalProvider(LocalLayoutDirection) based on current locale.
data/preferences/PreferencesRepository.kt (DataStore) stores language key.
util/LocaleManager.kt exposes Flow<AppLanguage>.
strings.xml in values/, values-b+fr/, values-b+ar/ with ALL keys in Appendix B.
presentation/navigation/Screen.kt: @Serializable sealed interface (Dashboard, EmployeeList, EmployeeDetail(id), EmployeeEdit(id?), Import, Analytics, Settings).
AppNavigation.kt with NavHost + bottom bar (hidden on Detail/Edit/Import).
4 empty screens + MainActivity wiring.
phases.verify: App runs with 4 tabs; switching device to Arabic flips RTL and shows Arabic strings.

phases.name: Domain + Data
tasks: domain/model/Employee.kt (data class with id, fullName, dateOfBirth, hireDate, department, position, grade, salary?, email?, phone?, address?, notes?, createdAt, updatedAt; computed age + yearsOfService via Period).
data/local/entity/EmployeeEntity.kt (@Entity) mirroring model.
data/local/Converters.kt: LocalDate <-> Long (epochDay).
data/local/dao/EmployeeDao.kt: getAll(): Flow, getById, insert, insertAll, update, delete, count.
data/local/AppDatabase.kt v1 exposing employeeDao().
domain/repository/EmployeeRepository.kt (interface).
data/repository/EmployeeRepositoryImpl.kt with mappers.
di/DatabaseModule.kt + di/RepositoryModule.kt (Hilt).
Use cases: GetEmployees, GetEmployeeById, Create, Update, Delete, GetDashboardStats.
domain/model/DashboardStats.kt with AgeBucket + ServiceBucket enums.
phases.verify: Unit tests on in-memory Room DB pass: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest.

phases.name: Excel Import/Export
tasks: data/excel/EmployeeField.kt enum: FULL_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, HIRE_DATE, DEPARTMENT, POSITION, GRADE, SALARY, EMAIL, PHONE, ADDRESS, NOTES.
data/excel/ColumnDetector.kt: multilingual header patterns -> field (EN/FR/AR).
data/excel/DateParser.kt: dd/MM/yyyy, yyyy-MM-dd, dd-MM-yyyy, MM/dd/yyyy, Excel numeric.
data/excel/ExcelPreview.kt: headers, detectedMapping, sampleRows, totalRows.
data/excel/ExcelReader.kt: preview(uri): ExcelPreview; stream(uri, mapping): Flow<Employee>; Dispatchers.IO; close workbook; delay(1) per 100 rows.
data/excel/ExcelWriter.kt: export(employees, outputStream).
Use cases: PreviewExcelUseCase, ImportExcelUseCase (Flow<ImportProgress> with Progress/Done/Error), ExportExcelUseCase.
SAF helpers: OpenDocument + CreateDocument (MIME application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet).

phases.name: Dashboard UI
tasks: DashboardViewModel + DashboardUiState (Loading/Content/Error).
components/StatCard.kt: Material3 card, icon + label + big number with animateIntAsState (spring medium bouncy).
components/AgeChart.kt (Vico donut, animated draw on first composition).
components/ServiceChart.kt (Vico bar, animated entry).
DashboardScreen.kt: LazyColumn 16dp padding; 4 StatCards (Total, Avg Age, Avg Service, Retirement Soon), 2 charts, Recent 5; staggered AnimatedVisibility with delay index*60ms.
Debug 'Seed test data' button inserting 50 random employees.
phases.verify: Dashboard shows stats + animated charts; state survives rotation.

phases.name: Employee List UI
tasks: EmployeeListViewModel: query, filters (department, ageRange, serviceRange), sort; StateFlow<List<Employee>>.
components/EmployeeCard.kt: avatar with initials (deterministic color), name/position/department, chips for age + service years.
EmployeeListScreen.kt: custom SearchBar (debounced 200ms), FilterChips, Sort menu, LazyColumn with animateItem(), expandable FAB (Add + Import via scaleIn/Out), SwipeToDismissBox with undo Snackbar.
Empty state with Import CTA.
phases.verify: Search/filter/sort live; swipe deletes + undo restores; FAB expansion smooth.

phases.name: Employee Detail/Edit/Create UI
tasks: EmployeeDetailViewModel + EmployeeEditViewModel.
EmployeeDetailScreen.kt: large avatar, name, position; info cards (Personal, Professional, Notes); top bar with back/edit/delete; delete AlertDialog; Edit FAB.
EmployeeEditScreen.kt: OutlinedTextFields, M3 DatePickerDialog, validation (name non-blank, DOB past, hire>DOB, salary>=0), shake on invalid, disabled Save until valid, success check + pop.
Shared element transition: list card avatar -> detail avatar (SharedTransitionLayout + Modifier.sharedElement()).
Route /employee/edit?id={id?}.
phases.verify: Create/edit/delete all work; shared transition visible.

phases.name: Import Excel Wizard UI
tasks: ImportViewModel StateFlow: Idle/Picking/Mapping/Preview/Importing(progress)/Done(imported, failed)/Error.
ImportScreen.kt with HorizontalPager (4 pages) + animated page dots.
Step1 SelectFileStep: dashed-border card + OpenDocument launcher.
Step2 MappingStep: Excel header -> EmployeeField dropdowns (auto from ColumnDetector); Next enabled when FULL_NAME/DATE_OF_BIRTH/HIRE_DATE mapped.
Step3 PreviewStep: horizontal-scroll table, first 10 rows, mapped cols highlighted.
Step4 ImportingStep: circular progress with %.
Result: animated checkmark (Canvas path), counts, View Employees button; if failures -> Export error CSV.
State preserved across steps via ViewModel.
phases.verify: Real 100-row import works; wrong columns fixable in mapping; error report generated.

phases.name: Analytics UI
tasks: AnalyticsViewModel: distributions filtered by selected department(s).
AnalyticsScreen.kt: TabRow (Age|Service|Department|Grade) with AnimatedContent slide.
Age tab: donut + legend + avg + median.
Service tab: bar chart + avg + top 5 longest-serving.
Department tab: horizontal bar chart sorted by headcount.
Grade tab: pie chart.
Export analysis xlsx via top bar.
phases.verify: Charts render, filters animate, export produces valid xlsx.

phases.name: Settings UI
tasks: SettingsViewModel.
SettingsScreen.kt: Language (EN/FR/AR FilterChips w/ flag emoji), Theme (Light/Dark/System segmented), Export all, Import (replaces all) w/ confirm, Delete all (double confirm), About.
Language change updates DataStore; AppTheme recomposes with new locale + LocalLayoutDirection + AnimatedContent crossfade.
phases.verify: Language switches instantly (incl. RTL); theme switch animates.

phases.name: Polish
tasks: Haptic feedback on FAB / swipe / save.
Shimmer skeletons for loading (Brush.linearGradient animated offset).
Adaptive app icon (foreground + background).
core-splashscreen splash.
Content descriptions on all icons.
Test on Pixel 6 (API34), small phone (API26), tablet (API34).
./gradlew lint -> 0 errors.
phases.verify: Lint clean; UI tested on 3 form factors.

phases.name: Release
tasks: Create keystore; signing config reads from local.properties.
Release: isMinifyEnabled=true, isShrinkResources=true.
Verify ProGuard rules (POI/Room/Hilt/kotlinx.serialization).
./gradlew bundleRelease; smoke-test on device; AAB < 15MB.
phases.verify: AAB builds; installs; all features functional.

definitionOfDone: Installs on API 26 and API 34 without crash.
Excel import works for .xlsx with EN, FR, AR headers.
Dashboard shows live stats + 2 animated charts.
Analytics has 4 tabs, all charts render.
Language switching EN/FR/AR including full RTL flip.
Smooth animations: stat count-up, list entry, FAB expand, transitions, chart draw.
agentStart: Begin at Phase 1, task 1. Report build result after each phase.
